# Playtest diary: r11-typed-full

- **Mode:** typed
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a veteran Infocom player who played Planetfall in 1983 and expects the parser to be sharp
- **Seed:** 88180
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** d76debd
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 11
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-27/r11-typed-full.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

(About 100 words per 10 commands: what you tried, and what you believed.)

**Start.** Deck Twelve on the S.P.S. Duffy. Veteran of Planetfall; I remember from 1987 box lore that Stationfall has Floyd and a paperwork opening. Plan: explore, read everything, get the forms I'm sent for.


**Cmds 1-40.** Explored Deck Twelve (slot by port door spits my ID back; door closed), Forms Storage (aft; boxes readable with READ BOXES but not READ WRITING ON BOXES), Cargo Bay Entrance, Robot Pool. Robot form in slot + TYPE 3 got Floyd (bin 3, marbles). Spacetruck in Cargo Bay: need both seats filled, activation form in slot, then course from QX-17-T chart by current time. First run I left the hatch open and died in vacuum - fair, my fault. Restarted, closed hatch, typed 464 at time 4731, SAVEd. Launch succeeded. Note: forms say 'Deck Five' but the game calls it Deck Twelve (probably a canon joke). Assignment form 'has not been validated'.

**Cmds 40-90.** Trip: waited ~5 turns; TURN ON RADIO at arrival triggered docking (+5, 'Stationfall'). Radio mic missing, SAY rejected. Ate orange goo. Station Level Five: Docking Bay #2 (W), lobby, Workshop (N, took twenty-ohm bedistor), dark Storage beyond. North Junction, Sick Bay (ID reader security door E, my rank too low), East Connection (iris hatch + slot to Military Sub-Module), Comm Center (beacon button shocks), Station Control (monitors: COMM, FOOD red, PRINTING yellow), Commander's Office (fixed log reader), Commander's Quarters (safe 8000 settings, 12-20 numbers; tape on desk). Log: fuel cells locked in Dome storage bin, key in safe; alien craft in Docking Bay #1, pyramid moved to Sci Sub-Module tank; Shady Dan in village sells modded IDs; stamp under the bed; machine breakdowns = sabotage? Welder #1 hunts you - it zapped me while I kept pressing the button (my greed; it warns 3 turns). Restored. Found stamp under bed, stamped the assignment form (no points). Met Plato the robot. (From memory I half-recall Plato being trouble in Stationfall - persona stays neutral.)

**Cmds 90-146.** Briefing Room (S of Commander's Office), South Connection (iris hatch + slot, 'Diplomatic' socket - village?), Robot Shop (inert robot Oliver; heating chamber with drill bit - FLOYD, TAKE BIT, then take it: +3). South Junction; File Room SW is dark. Log reader in Commander's Office burned up (black scar) - as the log foretold. Plato and Floyd wander off to a 'library'. Up the ladder: Level Four (barracks N/S, SanFac, Docking Bay #3 with lilac nanofilm spool 'Spacetruck Refueling Instructions'). Level Three: Gym (exercise machine; sign: frequency 710 - don't bring broadcasters near). Welders #1 and #4 roam; walking away shakes them.

**Cmds 146-210.** Level Three: Theatre (projection booth locked), Laundry (presser, dryer, missing washer), Chapel (blinking star out of reach, eternal flame, pulpit hides switch that kills/relights flame; puce spool). Level Two: Mess Hall (FDU sprays ACID - food production is sabotaged; took a still-steaming coffee from an empty room), Main Storage (detonator containing a blackened hyperdiode), Meeting Rooms 1-2, Library (voice-only spool reader; terminal removed). Spools: refueling needs a 'quarnum wrench'; chapel star contains a hyperdiode -> theory: swap it into the detonator. Both spools end in 'You will die, human!' - something's corrupting machines. Dome (top): shrubbery, grating fixed, bin locked (key in the Commander's safe), bin warm. Parser: READ SPOOL while spool in reader pulls it out (friction); DROP SPOOLS asks which.

**Cmds 210-262.** Chapel pulpit sways if climbed - star unreachable so far. Grew weary; slept in Female Barracks bed (GET IN BED; SLEEP alone refused), woke day 2 (+3 = 11), everything dropped at bed. Auto-doors now sluggish and snapping shut - sabotage escalating. Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks/SanFac, Officers' Quarters A/B/C + SanFac (nothing), End of Corridor (security door N with ID reader; Shipping Room E is dark), Docking Bay #1 with alien ship: empty pedestal (pyramid was moved), skeleton with big tongue case, dots pattern `.. .. / .. .... . ... . ... ... . ... / .. ... . / .... . ... . / .. ... .` (groups 2 2 / 2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3 / 2 3 1 / 4 1 3 1 / 2 3 1). Docking Bay #4 empty. Hunger again, ate gray goo.

**Cmds 262-330.** Printing Plant (Level Seven): trash can had a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q; mauve spool; Paper Recycling Plant (NW) had a drill with small bit (tired motor, few uses). Ladder to Level Eight sealed from below; throbbing heartbeat + clanging below. Presser in Laundry ironed the form; stamped it; South Connection slot -> hatch half-opens (+6 = 17). Village (zero-g): Grimy Passage, Main Street, Travel Agency, Bank (platinum detector, now on), Greasy Straw (Ramosian Fire Nectar behind counter), Trading Post (fromitz board; sheet for FREZONE explosive: hole, detonator + timer, keep under 150K), Warehouse below (red sign: Vacuum Storage door leads down), Alley, Loan Shark (strong box, huge lock). Theory: blow the Commander's safe with Frezone + detonator (with star's good hyperdiode) + timer, drilled hole. Inventory limit 7 fumbles - juggling.

**Cmds 330-400.** Junk Yard (magnetic spaceboots - game warns they would wipe the ID card; left them). Shady Dan's (above Junk Yard): jerry-built machine, TURN ON, put ID in slot, TYPE 10 -> Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral (1 = Ensign). Grocery (plastic bag with vacuum taffy, used as extra container), Broadway, Recruitment Office, Field Office (headlamp - worn, lit; left mauve spool there), Fortune Teller (crystal ball), Rec Shop (simulation booth, flavour only). Makeshift Connector W from Broadway leads back into East Connection (its hatch is frozen open). The rank-10 card opens security doors: Sick Bay -> Brig (empty), End of Corridor N -> Armory (+5 = 22): fusor-beam zapgun, indicator '7'. Platinum detector 'warm' on Broadway, 'very warm' in Level Five lobby. Shipping Room (lit now): pallets of boxes, a sign over a vacant section. Saved in Armory.

## Leg handoff

### Map so far
- **Duffy (start):** Deck Twelve (slot, closed port door) - aft Forms Storage; starboard Cargo Bay Entrance - fore Robot Pool, starboard Cargo Bay (spacetruck).
- **Station ladder/elevator column (east side of every level):** Dome (top) / Level Two Mess Hall / Three / Four / Five / Six / Seven Printing Plant / Eight (ladder sealed from below).
- **Dome:** locked warm bin 'Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies' (fuel cells), fixed air-shaft grating.
- **L2:** Mess Hall; N Main Storage (loops SW/NW to Mess Hall S/N doors); NE Meeting Rm 1 - S Meeting Rm 2 - S Library (spool reader; spools dropped here: lilac, puce; log tape) - W back to Mess Hall.
- **L3:** N Gym (machine, freq 710 sign); S Theatre (locked projection booth); NW Laundry (presser, dryer, coffee dropped); SW Chapel (star, flame, pulpit switch).
- **L4:** N Female Barracks - SE SanFac - S Male Barracks - NW back; W Docking Bay #3.
- **L5:** W Docking Bay #2 (my spacetruck, hatch open); N Workshop - N Storage (dark); NE North Junction: E Sick Bay (sec. door E -> Brig) - SE East Connection (E -> village via Makeshift Connector; S Comm Center; SW Station Control - S Commander's Office: E Quarters (safe), S Briefing Room - W South Connection (W Robot Shop, S -> village Grimy Passage) - N South Junction (SW File Room dark, E Station Control)). North Junction also has a N corridor and NE doorway - unexplored.
- **L6:** N Aux Barracks - E Aux SanFac; S Officers' Qtrs A - SE SanFac - N Qtrs B, NE Qtrs C - N End of Corridor (N Armory via ID, E Shipping Room, SW Qtrs B); NW Docking Bay #1 (alien ship); SW Docking Bay #4.
- **L7:** Printing Plant, NW Paper Recycling Plant.
- **Village (zero-g):** Grimy Passage - Main Street (W Travel Agency - SE Bank - N Main Street; NE Greasy Straw - NE Trading Post; up/S/SE unexplored). Trading Post: N Grocery - N Broadway (N Recruitment, E Field Office, D Fortune Teller, NE Rec Shop, W Makeshift Connector -> East Connection); D Warehouse (vacuum storage door down) - SW Alley (S Loan Shark, E Junk Yard - U Shady Dan's - NW Trading Post).

### Puzzles solved
- Get Floyd: robot form in Robot Pool slot, TYPE 3.
- Launch: close hatch, sit in pilot seat (Floyd takes copilot), activation form in slot, TYPE course from QX-17-T chart by the current time; TURN ON RADIO near the station to dock (+5).
- Stamp under the Commander's bed (LOOK UNDER BED).
- Drill bit: FLOYD, TAKE BIT from heating chamber (+3).
- Sleep in a bed (+3).
- Village: crumpled entry form (Printing Plant trash) -> presser -> stamp -> South Connection slot (+6).
- ID rank: Shady Dan's machine, TYPE 10 -> HyperAdmiral; opens security doors (Armory +5).

### Open puzzles and theories
- Commander's safe (key to Dome bin with fuel cells). Theory: FREZONE explosive (Trading Post sells it; vacuum storage below Warehouse?) + detonator (in Armory, holding blackened hyperdiode) with a good hyperdiode (Chapel star, per puce spool) + a timer, in a hole drilled with drill (tired motor - few uses; medium bit vs small bit).
- Chapel star out of reach (pulpit sways). Zapgun (7 charges) to shoot it down? Or Floyd?
- Alien dots: groups 2 2 / 2 4 1 3 1 3 3 1 3 / 2 3 1 / 4 1 3 1 / 2 3 1 - maybe safe combination or language.
- Refueling spacetruck needs a quarnum wrench.
- Something is corrupting machines (welders hunt you; spools/FDU/doors sabotaged). Pyramid is in Sci Sub-Module holding tank (not found yet). Plato always tags along with Floyd (my memory says be wary; unconfirmed on screen).
- Platinum detector warm near Broadway, very warm at Level Five lobby. Loan Shark strong box. Theatre booth locked. Comm Center has a message but button shocks. Gym freq 710.

### What I would try next
- Shoot the Chapel star with the zapgun (or ask Floyd) to get the hyperdiode; put it in the detonator (left in Armory).
- Explore North Junction N/NE, File Room and Workshop Storage with the headlamp, the Main Street up/S/SE exits, and the Warehouse vacuum door (magnetic boots? need a suit).
- Find Frezone and a timer; drill the safe.
- Keep saving; welders give 3 turns warning - leave the room.

## Leg 2

Start: Shipping Room, score 22, time 4230. Carrying zapgun, headlamp, drill + bits, detector, bag, survival kit. Plan: search Shipping Room, shoot the Chapel star, explore dark rooms with headlamp.

**L2 cmds 1-30.** Shipping Room sign: return the forklift (forklift missing). Drank blue soup. Workshop Storage (dark) held a jammer (black box, antenna, 20 sockets, freq 0-1400, set 337, off); platinum detector went too hot there and I dropped it (odd: implicit take then worked). East of Storage: North Connection -> Tube -> Scientific Sub-Module. Engineering Lab (mid level), Engineering Office N: Prof. Schmidt's diary - pyramid >1 billion years old; alien dots decoded by 'nonvisual properties'; 'my pal, the mayor, will show off his linguistic training'. Astro Lab (up): twenty-prong fromitz board -> put in jammer. Headlamp dimming; turned off when not needed.

**L2 cmds 30-70.** Sub-Module: Astro Office, Scientists' Quarters (up), Bio Lab (down) with Bio Office note: 'think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph...' (bloodstained). Holding Tank Level: tank blasted open, empty - the pyramid is loose. PX (NE of North Junction / E of North Connection): Vendo-Matic, 1 galakmid each: #6 All-Purpose Timer, #9 Large Drill Bit. Need a coin. Chapel: SHOOT STAR WITH ZAPGUN vaporised the star (footnote 9 joke). My own fault; RESTOREd Armory save (lost ~40 cmds), re-fetched jammer+board. Now waiting for Floyd to try 'Floyd, climb pulpit'/steady it.

**L2 cmds 70-110.** Floyd refuses to climb/hold the pulpit ('Floyd shorter even than you!'); FLOYD, FOLLOW ME works but he wanders off with Plato again. Elevator (weightless shaft; push button to call): keypad, 8 won't move. File Room: nothing. Mayor's Office (UP from Main Street): book 'Deciphering Alien Speech' with a paper - a TASTE lexicon (bttr/salty/sweet/sour/blnd/spicy-hot combos -> words: softness, Hunji, Zeenak, air, died, sabotage, turn back, 'I have shined light upon', brethren, is souring, deadly radiations, 78 or 7/8, weapon...). So the alien dots are tasted (skeleton's big tongue!). Kept paper in kit.

**L2 cmds 110-140.** Village exits: Bank has nothing more; Alley SW = Pawn Shop (spray can 'E-Z SPRAY SPORZ, spores, lowest gas-inducement' - took it); Alley N = Missionary (nothing); Alley SE = 'Doc' Schuster's: letter ('ostrich nip ... you'll find it in my ceiling panel') and a floating 3 m ostrich. Hunting for the ceiling panel: not Greasy Straw, Travel Agency, Loan Shark, Junk Yard, Shady Dan's. Strong box 'HUGE lock'. Welders 3 and 4 roam the village too.

**L2 cmds 140-175.** Barbershop (E of Grocery; mirror), Pet Store (SW of Broadway): sign about Arcturian balloon creatures (hydrogen, float in gravity, feed on airborne spores, propel by farting). EXAMINE CEILING revealed a panel -> stick of ostrich nip (+3 = 25). Opened cage: creature floats out; TAKE LEASH in zero-g makes it fart, I drop everything. Then in Trading Post Plato ambushed me with a stun ray and monologued: pyramid is a Zeenak weapon vs the Hunji, turns machines against creators, builds a replica factory. Floyd knocked the gun away; it exploded, Plato destroyed (+7 = 32). Floyd weeping oil. My memory had whispered Plato was a villain - confirmed on screen now.

**L2 cmds 175-205.** Nip lured the ostrich from Doc's; it followed me (lovely gravity/weightless bellyflop text) by elevator to the Chapel. But GIVE NIP TO OSTRICH just gets it drunk and asleep - probably wasted (can't stand on it, 'too complex for a crufty program'). New theory: the hydrogen balloon creature floats in gravity; lure with spores (spray can), kill the flame via pulpit switch first, and let it bump the star. Back at the Pet Store to try.

**L2 cmds 205-240.** Balloon creature: grabbing it in zero-g always farts (hint says try gravity). Spraying spores in an adjacent room makes it 'fart in' to eat - I led it Pet Store -> Broadway -> Makeshift Connector -> East Connection (gravity). TAKE LEASH in gravity: it hyperinflates and LIFTS ME two metres! That's the Chapel star solution. TAKE ALL keeps trying to pick up Floyd (wastes a turn with welders around). Getting weary again - need a bed soon.

**L2 cmds 240-275.** Led the balloon creature with spore sprays East Junction -> North Junction -> L5 -> ladder L4 -> L3 -> Chapel (it follows up ladders fine). Killed the flame (pulpit switch) first, sprayed, TAKE LEASH lifted me: TAKE STAR (+7 = 39). Relit flame, balloon shot out. Saved in Chapel. Slept in Female Barracks: Novem 6; chronometer stopped (no time display now); Floyd is turning surly (stomps foot, curses, 'humans take orders from robots') - the pyramid is getting to him. Star opens: M-series hyperdiode.

**L2 cmds 275-300.** Walking to the Armory I typed E at Level Six (thinking it led back to End of Corridor, since End of Corridor W reached Level Six) - it's the elevator shaft, now with gravity switched on: fell to my death. Restored the Chapel save; redid star/hyperdiode/sleep (you fall asleep immediately on entering the barracks when exhausted). Correct route is Level Six SE. Armory: swapped M-series hyperdiode into the detonator (removed the blackened one), closed and took it. No points yet. Floyd increasingly nasty. Need: galakmid for the PX timer, Frezone.

**L2 cmds 300-400.** Village sweep for a galakmid: Fortune Teller crystal ball (LOOK IN BALL = fortune-teller tips, joke), Recruitment posters, Rec Shop - no coin. Trading Post sign: 'FREZONE explosive available', 'illegal wares by appointment'. Warehouse red sign: 'TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE AREA - trespassers will be spaced'. Inner door -> Airlock ('SECURE ALL OPEN CONTAINERS BEFORE DEPRESSURIZATION'; Floyd won't fit). Closed Thermos, cycled the lock, opened lower door -> lungs ruptured. Fair. Restored Warehouse save. Drank the fire nectar (hunger). Walked to Docking Bay #2 to search the spacetruck for a suit - the radio crackles 'Breaker. Over.' Leg budget ran out there.

## Leg 2 handoff

**Score 39/80, Day 3 (chronometer stopped), in the Spacetruck (Docking Bay #2), Floyd with me (turning surly under the pyramid's influence). Latest save: Warehouse (day 3, 39).**
Carrying: spray can (spores), survival kit (medium drill bit, taste-lexicon paper, assignment form, stamp, closed Thermos), zapgun, drill (small bit), detonator (closed, good M-series hyperdiode inside). Wearing headlamp (dimming; off), uniform + ID (rank HyperAdmiral), stopped chronometer.
Left behind: jammer+fromitz board and plastic bag (bedistor) in Trading Post; platinum detector in Workshop Storage (it overheats there); star shell in Chapel; blackened hyperdiode in Armory; drunk ostrich in Chapel; balloon creature last seen Level Three lobby.

### Map additions this leg
- **L5:** Workshop N -> Storage (dark; jammer was here) -> E North Connection (N Tube -> Sci Sub-Module; E The PX; S North Junction). North Junction NE also = PX; SE = East Junction (E East Connection -> Makeshift Connector -> Broadway).
- **Sci Sub-Module (vertical, gangways):** Scientists' Quarters / Astro Lab (+N Astro Office) / Engineering Lab (+N Engineering Office: Schmidt's diary) / Bio Lab (+N Bio Office: 'bacteriophage' note) / Holding Tank Level (tank blasted open, empty).
- **L6:** End of Corridor is SE of Level Six (its W exit returns to Level Six). **Level Six E = elevator shaft - deadly now that shaft gravity is on.**
- **Village:** Main Street U = Mayor's Office (book, taste lexicon). Alley: SW Pawn Shop (spray can), N Missionary, SE Doc Schuster's (letter; disposal-chute hole), NE Warehouse (-> Airlock D -> vacuum). Grocery E = Barbershop (mirror) -> NW Broadway. Broadway SW = Pet Store (ceiling panel; cage).
- **Elevator:** keypad, TYPE n; 8 won't go. Shaft gravity now broken (1 G) - call the elevator before stepping east!

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Plato is the villain: he stuns you in the village and monologues; FLOYD, KILL PLATO (any Floyd order) and wait -> Floyd saves you (+7).
- Ostrich nip: EXAMINE CEILING in Pet Store -> panel -> nip (+3).
- Chapel star: lead the balloon creature into gravity by spraying spores room to room; turn off flame (pulpit switch); TAKE LEASH lifts you; TAKE STAR (+7). OPEN STAR -> M-series hyperdiode -> into detonator.

### Open puzzles and theories
- **Galakmid coin** for PX Vendo-Matic (#6 All-Purpose Timer, #9 Large Drill Bit). Not found anywhere searched. Maybe the Loan Shark strong box (huge lock) - but that likely needs the explosive. Maybe Commander's safe. Maybe hidden (EXAMINE CEILING worked once - try it / LOOK UNDER in other rooms).
- **Frezone**: probably in Trading Post Vacuum Storage below the Warehouse airlock. Need a spacesuit (none found yet) - check the spacetruck rear/lockers, docking bays #3/#4, Theatre projection booth, Duffy? Keep Frezone under 150K (vacuum storage keeps it cold; maybe the Thermos carries it cold - 'secure all open containers').
- **Commander's safe**: explosive + detonator (done) + timer + hole (drill: medium bit? large bit?).
- **Alien dots** are to be TASTED (skeleton's big tongue). Lexicon paper in kit: dots groups map to tastes. Go to Docking Bay #1 alien ship, TASTE DOTS / LICK WALL.
- Ostrich: drunk in Chapel after I fed it the nip (probably premature). Maybe meant for the Doc's disposal chute or something tall.
- Jammer (freq 0-1400, board fitted, off, set 337): gym sign says frequency 710; jam the pyramid / welders? Twenty-ohm bedistor use unknown.
- Level Eight sealed (heartbeat, clanging) - pyramid's replica factory. Elevator refuses 8.
- Floyd degrading - maybe jammer protects him.
- Spacetruck refuelling needs a quarnum wrench; radio now crackling 'Breaker. Over.' - try TALK/ANSWER.

### What I would try next
1. Answer the spacetruck radio; search the truck rear for a suit.
2. Taste the alien ship dots with the lexicon.
3. Set the jammer to 710 and turn it on (test near the gym / Floyd / welders).
4. Hunt the galakmid (EXAMINE CEILING / LOOK UNDER in station rooms, Commander's quarters, barracks cubicles).
5. SAVE before every elevator trip; always PUSH BUTTON before stepping east into a shaft.

## Leg 3

Start: Spacetruck in Docking Bay #2, score 39, day 3. Plan: answer the radio, search truck for a suit, then taste the alien dots.

**L3 cmds 1-25.** Radio just hisses. Alien ship: TASTE DOTS gives a taste sequence; with the Mayor's lexicon it reads roughly "Brethren Hunji: sabotage failed. However, I have shined light upon the Zeenak weapon's solitary weakness: element 78 [platinum]. Turn back the deadly radiations. The air is souring." So platinum defeats the pyramid. Picked up the platinum detector in Workshop Storage (it's silent there now - earlier heat was maybe the jammer?). Went to Loan Shark: DRILL LOCK warns the drill has one hole left - saving it for the Commander's safe.

**L3 cmds 25-45.** Airlock again: no suit, HOLD BREATH unknown word. Trading Post sign: 'IF YOU DON'T SEE IT ASK FOR IT' but nobody to ask. Swapped zapgun (left in Trading Post) for the jammer; set it to 710 and turned it on (theory: jams welders/pyramid). Detector said 'getting warm' entering Broadway but none of Broadway's side rooms changed it, and there's no way to read its current level - suspect the platinum source moves. Heading to the Commander's safe to study it.

**L3 cmds 45-70.** Commander's safe: DRILL SAFE also warns one hole left (small toothpick bit loaded; medium = pencil). Didn't spend it - unsure which bit the Frezone wants. Detector said 'very warm' in Commander's Quarters while I stood still - source seems to move (pyramid?). Jammer at 710 does NOT stop welders. Doc's disposal hole tugs your hand (vacuum). Village fully mapped; no galakmid. Theory now: Floyd can't share the airlock with me, so maybe Floyd goes down alone (robots don't breathe) to fetch the Frezone. Looking for Floyd.

**L3 cmds 70-95.** Detector went 'too hot' and dropped at South Junction (Welder #2 passing). Now I suspect the detector just heats up while switched on, independent of location - turned it off (implicit take ignored 'too hot', filed as bug). Hungry: Mess Hall FDU still sprays acid (can't catch it, 'acid' unknown word). Main Storage organics inedible. Looking for food.

**L3 cmds 95-125.** Drank the Laundry coffee out of hunger: POISONED, died. Restored Mess Hall save. Found I'd never tried Grocery SE: Saloon -> E Casino (dice, roulette). SPIN WHEEL opened exits N and up (+4 = 43). N Opium Den (anti-drug sign). Up Flophouse: locker with a SPACE SUIT. Inventory weight forced me to drop jammer, detector and drill in the Flophouse; wearing the suit. Now: Warehouse airlock -> vacuum storage for Frezone. Still ravenous - need food soon.

**L3 cmds 125-150.** Faint with hunger; a fresh cup of fire nectar was behind the Greasy Straw counter (must remove suit to drink; game notes 'That was the last food you will find'). First airlock trip in suit: blown out into space (need to cling). Restored; left ID card in Junk Yard, wore the magnetic boots: vac yard reached (+3 = 46). Headlamp revealed a tiny Frezone cylinder; put it in the Thermos and closed it (keeps it cold, I hope). Back in Warehouse, saved. Next: fetch drill, get ID back, find a galakmid/timer, then the Commander's safe.

**L3 cmds 150-180.** Frezone sheet (Shady Dan's): insert in hole of appropriate diameter, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, vamoose; keep <150K. Casino dice = joke. Retrieved drill; ID back in uniform, boots left in Junk Yard. Remembered the zapgun vaporised the Chapel star - SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN vaporised the strong box, leaving a galakmid (+5 = 51). Off to the PX for the timer.

**L3 cmds 180-200.** The suit won't fit through the half-open South Connection iris - dropped it in Grimy Passage. Explosive started 'getting softer' then 'melting' even in the closed Thermos (only slows it) - it's a timed run. PX: coin in slot, TYPE 6 -> 'klunk', timer stuck; kick/shake fail; REACH INTO HOLE: fingertips touch it but no grip. Theory: Floyd's small hands. Frezone run is premature - will probably have to restore to the Warehouse save before the vac yard once I know the timer trick. Looking for Floyd.

**L3 cmds 200-225.** Explosive melted en route ('game can no longer be won' notice - helpful). Restored Warehouse (43, before the vac yard). Re-did: ID back, zapgun, drill, shoot strong box -> coin (+5 = 48). Suit and boots left in Warehouse. New order: PX timer (need Floyd's small hands?), pre-drill the safe, THEN fetch the Frezone and run to the Commander's Quarters.

**L3 cmds 225-250.** PX again: coin in, TYPE 6, klunk, stuck. LOOK IN HOLE: blackness. Searched for Floyd (Library, Docking Bay #2, spacetruck) - not found; no way to call him. Other theories for the stuck timer: magnetic boots as a magnet; the ostrich's long neck (it's drunk-asleep in the Chapel after I fed it nip). Continuing the Floyd hunt.

**L3 cmds 250-270.** Floyd hunt: not in Chapel (ostrich awake there, won't follow), Gym, barracks, Docking Bay #3, L6 corridor, Printing Plant. Suspect he's been drawn down toward Level Eight. Trying the magnetic boots on the stuck timer instead (long walk to the Warehouse).

**L3 cmds 270-400.** Magnetic boots up the PX hole: drop straight out. TYPE 6 again: 'You have not deposited a coin' (coin spent, timer stuck inside). Growing weary; walked toward Sick Bay beds when the leg budget ran out at North Junction.

## Leg 3 handoff

**Score 48/80 (best reached 51 in a discarded timeline), Day 3, at North Junction, weary (need a bed - Sick Bay E of North Junction has beds). Floyd missing. Latest save: Loan Shark (48, coin in hand).**
Carrying: detonator (good M-series hyperdiode inside), survival kit (medium bit, taste-lexicon paper, assignment form, stamp, Thermos - open, empty), zapgun, drill (small bit, ONE hole left). Wearing headlamp, uniform + ID (HyperAdmiral), stopped chronometer. Magnetic boots left on the PX floor.
Left behind: space suit + spray can in Warehouse; jammer, platinum detector in Flophouse; Frezone instruction sheet at Shady Dan's; plastic bag (bedistor) in Trading Post; ostrich (awake) in Chapel; balloon creature in Level Three lobby.

### Map additions this leg
- **Village:** Grocery SE = Saloon (W -> Trading Post, NW -> Grocery, E disguised exit) -> Casino (dice, roulette). SPIN WHEEL opens N = Opium Den (sign) and U = Flophouse (locker: space suit).
- **Warehouse airlock -> 'In Space' vac yard** (needs suit + magnetic boots worn; headlamp shows the Frezone cylinder). Boots wipe ID - leave the ID card somewhere first.
- Suit is too bulky for the half-open South Connection iris; use the Makeshift Connector (East Connection) route instead.

### Puzzles solved this leg
- Alien dots: TASTE DOTS + Mayor's lexicon = 'Brethren Hunji, sabotage failed; the Zeenak weapon's only weakness is element 78 (platinum); turn back the deadly radiations'.
- Casino roulette: SPIN WHEEL (+4).
- Vac yard: suit + boots, close upper door, open lower door, D (+3). Frezone found.
- Galakmid: SHOOT LOCK WITH ZAPGUN at the Loan Shark strong box, TAKE COIN (+5).

### Open puzzles and theories
- **PX timer stuck** after coin + TYPE 6. Reach: fingertips only; kick/shake/drill/boots fail. Strong theory: Floyd's small hands (FLOYD, GET TIMER). Also possible: ostrich's long neck. The coin is spent in the current state - if Floyd can't be found, restore the Loan Shark save and bring Floyd first.
- **Frezone melts** once out of the vac yard (Thermos only slows it; lost around 25-30 moves). Do everything else FIRST: timer in hand, safe pre-drilled (I'd use the MEDIUM bit - it's the one worth points; one drill hole left), detonator ready. Then suit+boots (ID left behind), fetch Frezone, run Warehouse -> TP -> Grocery -> Broadway -> Makeshift -> East Connection -> SW Station Control -> S Office -> E Quarters (~10 moves). Put explosive in hole, attach detonator to explosive and timer, set timer, leave.
- Safe holds the Dome bin key (fuel cells). Then quarnum wrench to refuel?
- Platinum = pyramid weakness. Detector seems to just heat up when left on (maybe not location-based) - untested properly.
- Level Eight sealed (pyramid factory). Floyd probably drawn there / turning evil.
- Jammer (set 710) doesn't stop welders.

### What I would try next
1. Sleep in Sick Bay (GET IN BED), see if Floyd shows up on waking.
2. Find Floyd, bring him to the PX: FLOYD, GET TIMER (or REACH INTO HOLE).
3. Pre-drill the safe with the medium bit; then the Frezone run as above.

## Leg 4

Start: North Junction, score 48, day 3, weary. 300 commands left of the cap. Plan: sleep in Sick Bay, find Floyd, get him to fish the PX timer out.

**L4 cmds 1-30.** Slept in Sick Bay (Novem 7, day 4). Station lights failed (South Connection: 'lights flicker and go out'); headlamp needed everywhere now and dimming. Hungry again, and last leg the game said the fire nectar was the last food, so this is now a race. Floyd hunt: not in Robot Shop (only sleeping Oliver, 2-20 day incubation), Library, Dome, lobbies L2-L7, Paper Recycling, Docking Bay #1. 'WHERE IS FLOYD' -> 'Beats me.' Level Eight ladder still sealed. Welders 1 and 3 still wander. RESTORE with no number then LOOK gave a bare 'Failed.'

**L4 cmds 30-60.** Also checked Docking Bay #4, Shipping Room - no Floyd. CALL FLOYD: 'can't see Floyd here'; SHOUT not a verb. Then the headlamp died in Workshop Storage and the game declared itself unwinnable (explosive needs light). Restored Loan Shark (day 3, 48, coin in hand, lamp off, lights on). Walked to the PX via the village. Coin + TYPE 6 = klunk again. HIT MACHINE: 'fails to dislodge the timer' (so hitting is the right genre of verb?); TILT unknown; PUT DRILL IN HOLE: drops out. Saved in PX before the coin. Now hunting Floyd with the lights still on: not in the spacetruck (radio: 'Breaker. Over.').

**L4 cmds 60-95.** Floyd not in the Commander's rooms, Briefing Room or the whole Sci Sub-Module. Comm Center message: 'Abort assignment and return to Duffy' (joke). PX: SHOOT DISPENSER WITH ZAPGUN vaporises the whole machine (my gamble; restored the PX save). Decision: Floyd is lost in this timeline. Restoring the old Warehouse save (day 3, 39, move 654), when Floyd was still with me, and redoing coin/casino with FLOYD, FOLLOW ME, keeping him glued to me until the timer is out.

**L4 cmds 95-145.** Restored Warehouse day 3 (39): Floyd meandered in. FLOYD, FOLLOW ME -> 'Okay!', he followed two rooms, then vanished while I shot the strong box (+5 = 44, coin). Went back for him: gone. Drank the Greasy Straw nectar (ravenous), saved there (overwrote the 654 save). At the PX, waited 3 turns: no Floyd. 155 commands left of the cap - time to commit.

**L4 cmds 145-175.** Coin + TYPE 6: klunk; SHAKE -> 'fails to dislodge the timer'. Went to the Commander's Quarters: swapped in the medium bit (pencil), DRILL SAFE twice (first warns one job left) -> pencil-sized hole. Left drill, small bit, detonator there; saved. Casino SPIN WHEEL again (+4 = 48), wore the Flophouse space suit (spray can left there). Still no timer, no Floyd.

**L4 cmds 175-230.** Boots on (ID left in Junk Yard), saved at the Warehouse, airlock -> vac yard (+3 = 51). Cylinder is 'size and shape of a pencil', so the medium bit was right. Explosive went into the Thermos; returned. The suit is too bulky even for the East Connection iris (it says 'frozen open'!), so I dropped it in the Makeshift Connector. PUT EXPLOSIVE IN HOLE (+3 = 54), saved in Quarters. ATTACH DETONATOR TO EXPLOSIVE worked (footnote 13); the detonator has 'two connection points', the second for a timer. Chronometer refused. SHOOT DETONATOR vaporised it (restored). SHOOT SAFE: glows, cools. No timer = stuck.

**L4 cmds 230-255.** PUSH DETONATOR: no effect. Restored the Warehouse save (48, suit + boots on, no explosive yet) to hunt Floyd before the vac yard. Village sweep: Alley, Pawn Shop, Doc's, Missionary, Main Street, Mayor, Travel Agency, Bank, Greasy Straw, TP, Grocery, Barbershop, Broadway, Pet Store: no Floyd.

**L4 cmds 255-285.** Rest of village (Recruitment, Fortune Teller - ball just gives fortune-teller tips, Field Office, Rec Shop): no Floyd. Waited on Broadway 2 turns. Dropped the suit on Broadway, went into the station: Level Five, Workshop, Level Four, Female Barracks - no Floyd. Budget nearly gone.

**L4 cmds 285-300.** Male Barracks, SanFac, Docking Bay #3, Gym, Chapel (star back, drunk ostrich), Laundry, Theatre (booth: zapgun only glows it, knock no effect), Library: no Floyd anywhere. The 1500-command cap was reached in the Library.

## Final handoff (cap reached, not won)

**Best score 54/80** (Commander's Quarters, explosive in the drilled hole, in a restored-away timeline). **Ended at 48** in the Library, day 3, hungry, wearing magnetic boots. ID card is in the Junk Yard and the suit is on Broadway.

### Map
As in the earlier handoffs; nothing new this leg. The Theatre projection booth is still locked.

### Puzzles solved this leg (confirmed)
- The explosive is 'the size and shape of a pencil', so drill the safe with the MEDIUM bit (DRILL SAFE twice). PUT EXPLOSIVE IN HOLE scores +3. ATTACH DETONATOR TO EXPLOSIVE works; the detonator has a second connection point for the timer.
- Vac-yard run: Warehouse -> TP -> Grocery -> Broadway -> Makeshift -> (drop the suit; it won't pass the East Connection iris) -> East Connection -> SW -> S -> E. That is about 12 moves, and the explosive held.

### Open puzzles
- **PX timer stuck** (the blocker). HIT, SHAKE, KICK, REACH, drill or boots up the hole all fail; SHOOT DISPENSER destroys it. The theory is still that Floyd's small hand gets it, but Floyd drifts away despite FOLLOW ME and never comes back. Get the timer on day 2 while Floyd is still loyal and near.
- Theatre booth, Level Eight (pyramid factory), platinum weakness, quarnum wrench, the jammer at 710: all untested this leg.

### What I would try next
From a save with Floyd present: go straight to the PX, coin, TYPE 6, then FLOYD, REACH INTO HOLE / FLOYD, GET TIMER. Next, pre-drill (medium bit), fetch the Frezone and plant it, then ATTACH DETONATOR TO TIMER, SET TIMER, leave. Finally take the Dome bin key from the safe.

# Playtest diary: r11-click-fullA

- **Mode:** click
- **Start:** the start of the game
- **Persona:** a cautious first-time adventure player who reads every message and hates dying
- **Seed:** 26507
- **Conveniences:** on
- **Undo:** off
- **Build commit:** d76debd
- **Budget:** about 400 commands per leg, 1500 commands in all
- **Round:** 11
- **Friction log:** filed through the harness (--friction), in playtests/2026-09-27/r11-click-fullA.friction.jsonl

## Narrative

**Cmd 0.** Started on Deck Twelve with a uniform, ID card, chronometer and three forms. Plan: read everything, go slowly, save often (no undo this round).


**Cmds 1-13.** Read the green spacecraft form (nice paper viewer). Looked around the Forms Storage Room (just pallets). Went to Cargo Bay Entrance, then fore to the Robot Pool. The third robot is Floyd (from Planetfall - I know him from memory as well as from the screen). Put the robot form in the slot and typed 3; Floyd hugged me. Next: the cargo bay, and using the spacecraft form, probably in the slot by the port door.

**Cmds 14-33.** Took the survival kit (orange goo, gray goo, Thermos) in the spacetruck. The slot refused the form until both seats were filled. Floyd said "you first", so I sat in the pilot seat and he climbed in after me. The form was accepted; the time was 5489, so from the chart on form QX-17-T I typed 235, and we launched. After four waits we docked in bay two (+5). Nobody is there to meet us. I ate the orange goo (apricot yogurt) because I was hungry. Saved once before launching.

**Cmds 34-49.** Left the truck into Docking Bay #2, then east to Level Five (lobby, elevator, ladder). North is the Workshop, where I took a twenty-ohm bedistor. North of that is Storage, which is dark, so I backed out. Went NE to North Junction and east to Sick Bay, which has a security door with an ID reader; my card does nothing there. SE of that is East Connection (a sealed iris hatch, a slot) where hull welder #2 came at me "excited", so I retreated. Floyd has wandered off. NE of the junction is the PX: a vending machine costs 1 galakmid, and only the timer (6) and the drill bit (9) are in stock. I need money.

**Cmds 50-65.** North Connection leads through the Tube to the Scientific Sub-Module: Engineering Lab (middle), Engineering Office (Schmidt's diary about a billion-year-old alien pyramid; the dot markings have a 'nonvisual' property and 'the mayor has linguistic training'). Floyd came back with Plato, a polite librarian robot. Astro Lab (above) had a fromitz board, which I took. Astro Office and Scientists' Quarters hold nothing useful. The Ask menu for Plato lists only objects that are present, so I couldn't ask about the crew.

**Cmds 66-81.** Bio Office: a bloodstained note ('think of this station as a cell and the pyramid as a mechanized bacterioph...'). Holding Tank Level: the tank has been blasted open and is empty, so the pyramid is loose. The corridor ring runs Level Five, North Junction, East Junction, South Junction. Station Control's monitors show COMMUNICATION and FOOD PRODUCTION red and PRINTING yellow. Welder #1 came for me there, and I fled again. Sleepy in about 54 moves; there are beds in Sick Bay and Scientists' Quarters.

**Cmds 82-103.** The File Room (SW of South Junction) is dark. The Commander's Office (SE of South Junction) has a log reader; the Commander's Quarters (east of it) has the log tape, a safe with a dial, and a bed. What the log says: the fuel cells are locked in the Dome storage bin, and the key is in the Commander's safe. Shady Dan in the village sells modified ID cards, and the village is off-limits. The village entry-form stamp is hidden UNDER THE COMMANDER'S BED. The pyramid came from an alien ship in Docking Bay #1. Machines are failing (a welder injured an ensign), and the log ends mid-scream. I think the pyramid is corrupting the machines, which would explain the welders.

**Cmds 104-120.** Looked under the Commander's bed and found the validation stamp. The safe has a dial with 8000 settings and 12-20 numbers in the combination, so it looks uncrackable for now; maybe the drill bit from the PX? The Thermos holds blue soup. Saved, got in the bed, used "wait until tired", then slept (+3, score 8). It is now day 2 (Novem 5). Everything I carried was left in the room while I slept, and "take all" got it back. Hungry in about 56 moves.

**Cmds 121-140.** Day 2. The auto-doors are now sluggish and snap shut early, and the log reader has blown up (a black scar), so the sabotage is spreading. South of the Commander's Office is the Briefing Room, then west to South Connection (an iris hatch with a slot to the south, probably the village), then west to the Robot Shop. There, Oliver is an unborn robot, and a medium drill bit sits in a heating chamber whose opening is too small for my hand. Maybe Floyd could reach it? Up the ladder is Level Four: the barracks (nothing in the cubicles), a SanFac, and Docking Bay #3, where I took a lilac nanofilm spool. I dropped the diary to free space because the inventory is near full.

**Cmds 141-160.** Level Three: Gym (the exercise machine's sign warns against anything broadcasting on frequency 710, a hint that the radio could make the machine go haywire). Theatre (projection booth locked). Laundry (the washer is missing; a presser, which is off, and an empty dryer). Chapel (took a puce nanofilm spool; a seven-pointed star blinks rhythmically out of reach). Opened the pulpit and found a switch, and turning it off put out the eternal flame. Not sure why yet. Ate the gray goo (tree-mold custard). I think the spools go in the theatre projector and the stamp validates a village entry form.

**Cmds 161-182.** Level Two is the Mess Hall (cold coffee, food units). Main Storage (north/south, curved) had a detonator, which I took; inside it is a blackened hyperdiode. East of there are Meeting Rooms 1 and 2, then the Library, which has a nanofilm reader. The lilac spool gave a garbled manual on replacing spacetruck fuel cells (it needs a quarnum wrench). The puce spool covered chapel maintenance (the flame's fuel reservoir, and '...iode in the Chapel's star'). Both then turned to 'You will die, human!'. Theory: take the diode out of the chapel star to fix the detonator, then blow the safe for the key to the Dome storage bin and its fuel cells, so the truck can refuel and I can escape. A PA said a deep-space message is waiting at the Comm Center.

**Cmds 183-215.** Dome (top level): shrubs, an air shaft grating, and a locked storage bin marked 'Shrubbery Maintenance Supplies' (this must be where the fuel cells are). Went back to the Chapel. The pulpit sways when climbed. Floyd said "Floyd shorter even than you!" and Plato needs to be 'several meters taller', so the star is still out of reach. I took Floyd to the Robot Shop and told him to take the drill bit. He grabbed it, dropped it (hot), and gave a touching speech about Oliver waking up. I took the medium drill bit (+3, score 11). The PX sells a Large Drill Bit, and I suspect there is a drill somewhere.

**Cmds 216-240.** Level Six: Auxiliary Barracks and SanFac (empty). Docking Bay #1 holds the alien ship: an empty pedestal (where the pyramid sat), a skeleton, and dots on the wall. Touching and smelling the dots did nothing; the diary says the mayor could read them. The officers' quarters A/B/C and a SanFac hold nothing. End of Corridor has a security door with an ID reader to the north. The Shipping Room (east) is dark. That makes 3 dark rooms now (Storage, File Room, Shipping Room), and I have no light source.

**Cmds 241-252.** Docking Bay #4 is empty. Below Level Six is the Printing Plant: a mauve spool (not yet taken), a partition to the NW, and the ladder continues down ('special'). The trash can held a crumpled Illegal Space Village Entry Form FW-83-Q, which I validated with the stamp (no points). Welder #3 then approached, so I fled upstairs. There was also a creepy vibration and clanging from below. Next I'll try the validated form in the slot by the South Connection hatch.

**Cmds 253-273.** Saved at South Connection. The slot rejected the crumpled form ('crumpledness prevents it'). I walked it to the Laundry presser (open, put the form in, close, turn on, wait). It shuddered and billowed steam, so I turned it off and got back a neatly ironed form that is still validated. Next: the slot at South Connection.

**Cmds 274-290.** Put the ironed form in the South Connection slot. The iris hatch jammed half-open, which was enough to get through (+6, score 17). There is no gravity past the hatch. Grimy Passage leads to Main Street (exits up, down, NE, S, W, SE). West is the Travel Agency (posters), then SE to the Bank, where I took a floating platinum detector. The village is deserted.

**Cmds 291-300.** Turning on the platinum detector coincided with welder #1 appearing in the Bank, so I fled. From Main Street NE is the Greasy Straw (a restaurant), then the Trading Post, which has many exits. There I found a twelve-prong fromitz board and a FREZONE explosive instruction sheet: insert the explosive in a hole, attach the detonator to the explosive and the timer, set the timer, get away. It must be kept below 150 K for no more than 100 millichrons. The sign says FREZONE is sold here. Safe plan: drill + bit, then explosive (kept cold, maybe in the Thermos?), a detonator with a new diode from the chapel star, and a timer from the PX (1 galakmid; maybe the platinum detector finds a coin).

**Cmds 301-318.** Grocery (north of the Trading Post): ate the vacuum taffy, saving the Thermos for the cold explosive. Broadway, north of that, is a hub with 9 exits. In the Barbershop (east of the Grocery) the platinum detector beeped. After several fruitless tries I broke the mirror: the reflective foil behind it is the platinum (+4, score 21).

**Cmds 319-332.** Dropped the detector and the stamp. Recruitment Office (N of Broadway): posters. Field Office (E): took and wore a miner's headlamp, now on, so I finally have light for the dark rooms. Rec Shop (NE): simulation booths, which I avoided. Makeshift Connector (W) runs back to the East Connection iris hatch.

**Cmds 333-345.** Pet Store (SW of Broadway, SE of it is the Trading Post): an Arcturian balloon creature (hydrogen, floats in gravity, propels itself by farting). I opened the cage and it floated out. Grabbing its leash makes it fart in my face and I drop everything, twice. Floyd refused to take the leash (random 'Hider-and-Seeker' line). I used take all, and Floyd gave the assignment form back. Theory: a balloon creature on a leash in the station's gravity would rise to the chapel star, but I need something to block the smell (nose plug? gas mask?).

**Cmds 346-358.** East of the Trading Post are the Saloon (deserted) and then the Casino (dice, a roulette wheel). West is the Studio, whose scrap sculpture holds a J-series hyperdiode. I swapped it into the detonator and dropped the blackened one, so the detonator is presumably fixed. Still needed for the safe: a drill, the explosive (sold at the Trading Post, but no clerk is around), and the timer from the PX (costs 1 galakmid; the platinum foil might pay for it?).

**Cmds 359-371.** SE of the Trading Post is Shady Dan's (Dan is absent). It has a jerry-built 'innocuous machine' with a slot and keypad, plus a connector down. Saved first. Turned the machine on and put my ID card in; it reported 'Current rank is 6: Lieutenant First Class'. I typed 1, which turned out to be Ensign (the lowest), then typed 10: Grand Fleet HyperAdmiral. Took the card back. It should now open the security doors in Sick Bay and End of Corridor.

**Cmds 372-378.** Down from Shady Dan's is the Junk Yard, where the gag with the Studio is mirrored, so the double heading is deliberate. The magnetic boots there come with a warning that they would wipe my ID card, so I left them. West is the Alley (a hub, NW/Up to Main Street), with the Missionary (a kook) to the north. NE is a Warehouse: an airlock door leading down, with the sign 'TRADING POST VACUUM STORAGE AREA, Trespassers will be spaced!'. The FREZONE explosive is probably stored in the vacuum there, and I'd need a suit. Going back to test the upgraded ID card.

**Cmds 379-384.** Found the Mayor's Office (up from Main Street), with the book 'Deciphering Alien Speech'. Reading it dropped a paper: a glossary where the alien words are TASTES (bttr/salty/sweet/sour/blnd/spicy-hot) with meanings: sabotage, died/failed, deadly radiations, weapon, 'turn back', brethren, and '78 or 7/8'. So the dots in the alien ship are read by TASTING them (the dots menu has Taste). Also, Plato abruptly called me a 'simpleton human' and left with Floyd. I suspect Plato is being corrupted by the pyramid.

**Cmds 385-398.** Walked back to the station (gravity returns at South Connection). With the headlamp, the File Room turned out to hold nothing but 'boring' files. The HyperAdmiral card opened the Sick Bay security door into the Brig: three empty cells, nothing else. The door let me back out. The headlamp is dimming, so I turned it off. The auto-doors now snap shut 'almost nipping your heels'.

**Cmds 399-412.** PX: the foil 'doesn't fit the coin slot'. With the headlamp I found the Storage room (west of North Connection) and a jammer inside: a black box with 20 sockets, frequency 0-1400. I plugged in the twenty-prong fromitz board, took the jammer, and set it to 710, the gym machine's diagnostic frequency. Going to the Gym to try it. (I carelessly switched the lamp off inside the dark Storage room, but got out safely.)

**Cmds 413-~390 harness.** Saved on Level Three, turned the jammer on (710), and entered the Gym. Nothing happened after a wait, and 'turn on machine' says it is 'permanently on'. I didn't dare 'get in'.

## Leg handoff

**Final cmds (to 400).** Searched the gym machine, then got in and waited with the jammer on: nothing happened. Went to Level Six. The rank-10 card opened the End of Corridor security door into the **Armory** (+5, **score 26**), where I took a **fusor-beam zapgun** (indicator reads 7). This could shoot the chapel star or deal with the welders. The Shipping Room (lit with the lamp) holds the pallets of the **Request for ... Form Forms I was sent for**; the sign says to return the forklift here, and it is missing, so I need to find the forklift. The leg ended inside the Alien Ship, with the glossary paper in hand, before I could taste the dots.

**END STATE:** Alien Ship (Level 6, NW), score 26, day 2, time 6299. Floyd and Plato are nearby. Last save: Level Three, score 21.

### Map so far
- **Duffy:** Deck Twelve, with the Forms Storage Room aft; starboard is Cargo Bay Entrance, fore of it the Robot Pool, starboard of it the Cargo Bay (spacetruck).
- **Station Level 1 (top): Dome.** Shrubs, air shaft grating, locked storage bin (fuel cells).
- **Level 2: Mess Hall.** Main Storage is N and S (curved). NE is Meeting Room 1, then S to Meeting Room 2, then S to the Library (nanofilm reader), which also connects west back to the Mess Hall.
- **Level 3.** Gym N, Theatre S (booth locked), Laundry NW (presser, dryer), Chapel SW (star, flame, pulpit switch).
- **Level 4.** Female Barracks N, which runs SE to the SanFac, then S to the Male Barracks. Docking Bay #3 W.
- **Level 5.**
  - W: Docking Bay #2 (my truck).
  - N: Workshop, then N again to Storage (dark), which runs E to North Connection.
  - NE: North Junction. From there E is Sick Bay (security door E to the Brig, and SE to East Connection); NE is the PX; N is North Connection, which leads N via the Tube to the Sci Sub-Module (Engineering Lab and Office, Astro Lab and Office, Scientists' Quarters, Bio Lab and Office, Holding Tank).
  - SE: South Junction. From there E is Station Control; SE the Commander's Office (Quarters E, Briefing Room S); SW the File Room; S is South Connection (Robot Shop W, and the hatch S to the village).
  - East Junction lies between North and South Junctions, with East Connection east of it (iris hatch, plus Makeshift Connector to the village).
- **Level 6.** Auxiliary Barracks N (with SanFac); Docking Bay #1 NW (alien ship); Officers' Quarters A S; SE is the Officers' SanFac, Officers' Quarters B and C, and End of Corridor (a security door N, not yet opened; Shipping Room E, dark); Docking Bay #4 SW.
- **Level 7: Printing Plant.** Mauve spool, partition NW; the ladder continues down.

friction.why: Letter hint (ceiling panel, unsigned) + pet-store logic paid off; satisfying deduction

friction.result: ostrich sticks head up the hole, timer falls out, +6
friction.why: Wonderful payoff; the ostrich/nip/hole chain is a classic comic puzzle and felt earned

friction.result: explosive melted away before the timer fired; unwinnable notice
friction.why: Melt window after unbottling is only a few moves and the timer units are unstated; I spent 3 moves grabbing gear first. Fair but punishing; the unwinnable notice saved me

friction.result: The timer reaches 0 and stops ticking; no explosion; J-series hyperdiode silently gone from the detonator
friction.why: No feedback that the detonator is dud or why; the diode vanishes with no message. Cost 3 explosive runs to diagnose. If the J-series is a decoy, the game should say something when it fails (click, fizzle)

friction.command: spray can (in the room next to the creature)
friction.result: The balloon creature farts in, hungrily gobbling the spores
friction.why: Lovely discovery: the spore cloud lures the creature room to room, a fair and funny mechanic

friction.command: flame off; lure balloon in; take leash; open star; take hyperdiode
friction.result: lifted to the ceiling; M-series hyperdiode, +7
friction.why: Superb multi-step puzzle: spores lure, gravity buoyancy, flame safety. Very satisfying once found

friction.command: M-series diode in detonator; set timer 1; listen
friction.result: The timer reaches 0 ... You hear a click from the detonator. (J-series: no click, diode vanished)
friction.why: The click is a good confirmation signal, but only a player who tests with no explosive ever learns the J-series is a dud; with the J-series there is total silence

friction.command: explosive in hole, connect, timer 2, leave (with M-series diode)
friction.result: deafening explosion; safe blown open; key +7 (score 71)
friction.why: Big satisfying payoff after a long chain (coin, ostrich, balloon, vac yard). The hunger clock made it very tense but fair once routes were known

friction.command: death screen: 6 Restore your saved game
friction.result: Typed prompt [Type its number, 1 to 10] but the click options still only show Restore/Start again; no way to pick a save
friction.why: Still broken from leg 2: in click mode the death-screen restore cannot be completed; forces Start again then Restore

friction.command: open floor grating; shoot exercise machine; up
friction.result: exercise machine attacks, zap only makes it glow; blocks the ladder; death in ~3 turns
friction.why: Endgame arrival with no warning; fair (it is a save-point moment) but deadly and fast

friction.result: Option was in the jammer menu, which has closed
friction.why: Option numbers from a menu opened earlier die after another action; the combined thing+entry form works but was not obvious

friction.result: The light from the headlamp seems somewhat dimmer
friction.why: Good tension: a clear new clock in the endgame, noticed immediately

friction.result: Elevator shaft, gravity now 1G, plunge, died
friction.why: Compass label just says (shaft) right next to the loose air-shaft grating; easy to mistake the elevator shaft for the air shaft. Death is fair in canon, but the label invites it

friction.result: You collapse from extreme thirst and hunger
friction.why: Late-game starvation (the taffy is the last food) plus a 36-move launch clock and a dimming headlamp make any extra errand fatal; the jammer board lying in a far-off timeline room forces a 160-command replay. Very tight but fair; the Diagnose countdown on the button was a lifesaver for planning

friction.result: exercise machine diagnostic frequency 710; strangely no machine in the gym
friction.why: Clean, fair foreshadowing for the endgame: once you meet the machine in Computer Control the connection clicks

friction.result: elevator power-dives, death
friction.why: Fair trap (shaft now has gravity) but a hopeful shortcut to Computer Control; there is no warning besides the gravity line on entry

friction.result: Done; object panel then lists it as (in the exercise machine)
friction.why: Put ON was requested but the panel says IN; cosmetic, and the foil has no effect (fine), but the wording is inconsistent

friction.command: put can in chamber / wake Oliver / examine printing equipment
friction.result: polite, specific refusals (doesnt fit the opening; incubation period; outside your area of expertise)
friction.why: Unusual combinations get a tailored reply instead of a generic refusal, which rewards experimenting

friction.command: turn on Food Processing and Dispensing Unit
friction.result: cheery menu announcement, then a stream of acid
friction.why: Station Control shows FOOD PRODUCTION GREEN late in the game, which raised false hope; the acid gag is great, but the GREEN status reads as a hint when it is not one

friction.result: ran turn on machine (It is permanently on) instead of the More… entry Turn
friction.why: Phrase matching of <thing> <entry> picks the prefix match Turn on over the exact entry Turn hidden under More…; cost my last turn before death

friction.result: There is no one in the exercise machine. / You are not holding the exercise machine.
friction.why: Examine gives a vehicle-style reply with no description of the menacing machine; odd in the climactic room (may be canon; worth an oracle check)

friction.result: Level Eight and Nine plan (Computer Control on L9)
friction.why: The feelie blueprints are a great in-game reference, but I never opened them in 1480 commands; nothing nudges players toward them

# Playtest round 11: triage

Generated by `node scripts/playtest-registry.mjs report 11` from playtests/REGISTRY.jsonl and the round's friction JSONL. Do not edit by hand; re-run it.

118 friction rows this round (47 of them praise, counted and not triaged); 71 linked to 48 issues (8 new, 40 repeats); 0 not yet linked.

By tier: 11 A, 4 B, 33 C.

Suggested A/B/C is the registry's guess from the kind (A: build it, B: a deviation for the sponsor, C: leave it as the original). **Norm confirms each one** (`confirm <id> A|B|C`) after checking it against the ZIL and the oracle.

## New issues

| Issue | Title | Area / room | Kind | Rows this round | Rows in all | Rounds | Suggested | Norm confirms | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SF-225 | Shooting the chapel star with the zapgun vaporises it, and the hyperdiode with it | Station / Chapel | other | 1 | 1 | 11 | C | B | open | The shot is the original; the silence after it is the gap. V-SHOOT removes any TAKEBIT thing it hits ("A blaze of intense rays envelop the seven-pointed star. When the rays dissipate, the seven-pointed star is gone.", verbs.zil 1689-1712), and the star is TAKEBIT (station.zil 1492) and holds the M-series hyperdiode (DIODE-M IN STAR, station.zil 1533-1534). The M-series is the only diode that fires the detonator: at 0 the J-series is burnt out instead (I-TIMER, interrupts.zil 385-406; SF-170), and only the explosive opens the safe. So with the safe still shut, the game can no longer be won the moment the star is shot, and nothing says so: the D28 backstop's causes are the explosive, the drill, the card, the spray can and the dead lamp (rules/library.js:2956-3010), not the diode. The tester restored at once (transcript commands 460-463), calls the shot a fair Infocom consequence, and used the lesson later on the Loan Shark lock (praise r11-typed-full#25). C for the shot itself. **For the sponsor (B), as Q12 and Q13 were**. The options: (a) leave it silent, as the 1987 game; (b) add a sixth cause to the backstop, behind the conveniences switch: with DIODE-M out of the game and the safe shut, "(The game can no longer be won: the star is gone, and the hyperdiode inside it with it. RESTORE ...)", naming what happened and no way out; (c) (b) plus a line before the shot. Recommendation (b): it is the D28 item 4 pattern already built for Q12 and Q13, and it names only what the player just saw vanish. Default (b), reversible by the switch. Row: r11-typed-full#11. |
| SF-226 | Round 11 vocabulary: "items" (the vac yard's tethered items, the Junk Yard's floating items) and "inventory" as their noun | Parser / In Space | parse | 1 | 1 | 11 | A | A | open | D28 item 6, the standing rule. Printed: "Tethered all around you: those items in the Trading Post's inventory that ... must be stored here in space." (the vac yard, village.zil 1356-1358) and "Of all the items floating in the scrap heap, ..." (the Junk Yard, village.zil 1924). Oracle, seed 1, AFT + EXAMINE ITEMS: [I don't know the word "items."]; EXAMINE INVENTORY: [You used the word "inventory" in a way that I don't understand.]. Our engine says the same (transcript commands 1028-1029). Add, with the conveniences on (rules/library.js, the conveniences vocabulary, as SF-212): ITEMS, with TETHERED and FLOATING as adjectives, as scenery in the vac yard (the tethered stock) and on the Junk Yard's pile, so EXAMINE and TAKE get a plain refusal. INVENTORY as a noun of the vac-yard scenery only if the parser keeps a bare INVENTORY as the verb. Row: r11-typed-full#24. |
| SF-227 | Floyd wanders off and nothing calls him back: CALL FLOYD says he is not here, WHERE IS FLOYD "Beats me", SHOUT FLOYD is not a sentence | Robots / Spacetruck | tedious | 4 | 4 | 11 | B | C | left | The original. There is no way to summon Floyd in the 1987 game. CALL is V-CALL, which says CANT-SEE when he is not visible (verbs.zil 445-450). WHERE IS is V-FIND T (verbs.zil 2490-2491). SHOUT is YELL, which takes no direct object (syntax.zil 660-663). Oracle, route step 29 + SHOUT FLOYD: [That sentence isn't one I recognize.]; SHOUT TO FLOYD: "Aaaarrrggghhh!"; WHERE IS FLOYD (he is present): "Right in front of you.". Floyd follows only from the room you left, and then with PROB 80, and he wanders on his own (verbs.zil 2955-2958; interrupts.zil 291-300; SF-195, SF-167). FLOYD, FOLLOW ME is the original's way to keep him. The cost is real: r11-typed-full pinned the PX timer on Floyd and lost him for most of a leg (diary; the timer comes free with the nip and the ostrich, SF-044), and r11-click-fullA's medium bit sat in the heating chamber while he was away. Four rows in three runs: a repeat-C review (a convenience call, a deviation) if round 12 repeats it. Kept. Rows: r11-typed-full#27, #29, r11-click-fullA#35, r11-click-fullB#20. |
| SF-228 | Click menus: Floyd has no "Play with", though he begs for Hider-and-Seeker and PLAY WITH FLOYD is answered | Click menus / Warehouse | blocked | 2 | 2 | 11 | A | A | open | Ours (the menus, D15). FLOYD-F answers PLAY WITH: 30 millichrons of play, then "... you're completely winded. Floyd pokes at you gleefully. 'C'mon! Let's play some more!'", or, as ROBOT-EVILNESS rises, a win and a kick in the shin (ship.zil 552-571). He asks for it himself ("Enough talking! Let's play Hider-and-Seeker.", ship.zil 446; ASK ABOUT GAME, "Floyd loves games! Let's play!", globals.zil 678-681; "Play Hider-and-Seeker with Floyd?", interrupts.zil 166). Oracle, route step 29 + PLAY WITH FLOYD: the "completely winded" line, and our engine matches. Floyd's menus offer no Play: MORE_ACTOR is KICK, TOUCH, SMELL and SCARE (engine/zmenus.js:436), and Tell and Ask have no game. The tester read the begging as a real mechanic they could not reach, twice. Fix, interface only: add Play with (PLAY-WITH) to the robots' More… (engine/zmenus.js:436, MORE_ACTOR). It is flavour; the game's own reply then says so. Rows: r11-click-fullA#27, #38. |
| SF-229 | Take all sweeps up the magnetic boots with the ID card carried, and the card is wiped: the one D28 boots warning was already spent on an earlier single take | Village / Warehouse | blocked | 1 | 1 | 11 | A | A | open | Ours (D28 (1) and (5), SF-156). The boots warning is one per game (g.state.bootsWarned, BOOTS_WARN, rules/library.js:1384-1398). r11-click-fullB got it on TAKE BOOTS at command 344 (praise #8), then pressed the quick row's Take all in the Warehouse at 463: the sweep took the boots with the card carried, V-TAKE wiped the card (verbs.zil 1917-1927), and the backstop named it at once; the run restored (464). The scramble is canon. A sweep names nothing, so a one-time warning spent on an earlier single take does not reach it, and the Take all button is ours (engine/parser.js:663). Fix, interface only (in hand, not merged during round 11): TAKE ALL that would take the boots, or the card, with the other carried gets its own one-time warning and leaves that thing, in the game's voice, as the single-take warning does (rules/library.js BOOTS_WARN, with the parser's P.mult). Row: r11-click-fullB#15. |
| SF-230 | Computer Control: the exercise machine attacks the moment you drop in, and kills in three turns | Station / Computer Control | blocked | 1 | 1 | 11 | A | C | left | The original, the endgame's guard. Opening the grating from the Bottom of Air Shaft queues I-EXERCISE-MACHINE every turn (GRATING-F, station.zil 2167-2178): the first turn "rolls slowly towards you", the second "crashing violently", the third JIGS-UP (station.zil 3776-3806). Only the jammer, set to 710, turned on, with the fromitz board in it and in the room, stops it (station.zil 3778-3782). The Trading Post sign and the Gym's sign foreshadow it (praise r11-click-fullB#37). A fast, informed death at a save point (D28 item 4); the tester calls it fair. r11-click-fullB reached 73 of 80 here, the round's best. Kept. Row: r11-click-fullB#32. |
| SF-231 | Put on the exercise machine: "Done.", and the panel then lists the foil "(in the exercise machine)" | Station / Computer Control | bug | 1 | 1 | 11 | A | C | left | The original. PUT ON a VEHBIT thing is V-PUT (V-PUT-ON, verbs.zil 1538-1544), and the exercise machine is a vehicle, VEHBIT, INBIT, CONTBIT and OPENBIT (station.zil 1247). So "Done." puts the foil in it, and the panel's "(in the exercise machine)" says where it is. Kept. Row: r11-click-fullB#39. |
| SF-232 | Harness: "<thing> Turn" runs the first-level "Turn on" (a prefix match) instead of the exact "Turn" under More… | Harness / Computer Control | parse | 1 | 1 | 11 | A | A | open | Harness only. A "<thing> <entry>" phrase matches the first level's exact label, then an entry that takes a tail, then the first label that starts with the words (scripts/playtest.mjs:348-349). "651 Turn" found no exact "Turn" on the first level, and the prefix match took "Turn on" (TURN ON MACHINE, "It's permanently on.", transcript 1474), though "Turn" (V-SET) was in More…. That cost the tester's last turn before the machine killed them. Fix: look for an exact label among More…'s entries before the prefix match (scripts/playtest.mjs:348-349). Row: r11-click-fullB#42. |
